findings.summary: On mobile, Tab can move focus to page controls behind the open fixed sidebar while the drawer remains visible, obscuring the focused control.
findings.fix: Close the drawer when keyboard focus leaves it, without stealing focus, or make it modal by keeping focus inside and making background content inert; keep the expanded state synchronized.
findings.evidence: The sidebar stays open until Escape, a fragment link, or the toggle closes it; no focus-leave handler closes the fixed drawer.

notes: The focus-obscuring behavior is in the existing mobile sidebar interaction; this navigation-only change did not modify the drawer behavior.
